purpose: Freeze the only readout used to evaluate the new D512/L512 Method-v1 fields before any target-frame prediction or metric from those fields is opened.

signed_field_prompt.source: one complete factorized-v2 Method-v1 field per scene
signed_field_prompt.reference_prototypes: mean L2-normalized field features under the complete reference foreground mask and its complement
signed_field_prompt.permanent_outputs: scalar signed margins, receipts, hashes, and final field bindings

transient_sam.model: frozen official local SAM3 checkpoint bound by Method-v1 runtime
transient_sam.point_selection: deterministic signed weighted-farthest policy from radio_gs.querying.transient_rgb_sam

reference_selection.authority: the single canonical full reference mask only
reference_selection.tie_break: lowest candidate index, then lowest threshold

transient_sam.target_transfer: freeze the selected candidate index and threshold for every non-reference annotated frame in the scene
transient_sam.prediction_score: selected aggregate SAM probability minus the frozen reference-selected threshold

evaluation_barrier.aggregation: per-frame mean within scene, then unweighted nine-scene macro

claim_scope.historical_target_role: comparison target only; no historical branch or target metric may select the new Method-v1 prediction
